name: Mid Michigan Wood Specialties
old_description: Custom BUILT DOORS AND DRAWERS that save you time, labor, and callbacks.
about:
Mid Michigan Wood Specialties operates from Lyons, Michigan, where it was founded in 2006. The company began with three routers in a basement and has grown into a manufacturing partner for cabinetmakers and builders nationwide.

The shop focuses exclusively on cabinet doors, drawer fronts, dovetail drawer boxes, and face frames. By concentrating on these components, the team avoids the complexity of full cabinet assembly and directs its capacity toward precision parts built to customer specifications.

Customers include cabinetmakers, general contractors, and builders across Michigan and the broader United States. The company references serving "America's top cabinetmakers and builders" and positions itself as a supplier that helps professionals meet deadlines and reduce labor pressure.

The founders and many staff members come from the trades, giving them firsthand experience with tight timelines and the frustration of ill-fitting parts. Their stated mission is to deliver quality components on time with zero stress, and they emphasize that they never ship a piece they would not install in their own homes.
built_on: Exclusive focus on cabinet doors, drawer fronts, and dovetail drawer boxes
Mission to deliver quality parts on time with zero stress
Components shipped only if they meet the standard of the team's own homes
type_evidence: We don't build cabinets - and we don't try to. Instead, we put all our energy into the parts that builders trust us to get right: doors, drawers, and drawer boxes.
